scope: Local fork correctness tests and isolated-call gas diagnostics. No public-network transactions.
source_state: Working tree after final contract constants and removal of obsolete paid-harvest constants; hashes below authenticate this state.

routine_refill_change.meaning: Permission ceiling only. Increasing it creates no ETH and does not immediately refill spent capacity.

focused_runs.name: main correctness and regression run
focused_runs.source_variant: Final sync and unpaid-harvest behavior; tail120000/selected180000; before final pack-unit slope, refill-ceiling and unused-constant/comment cleanup.

earlier_focused_runs.source_variant: Initial sync funding implementation; before final marginal quotes and additional cases.
Initial marginal quotes; bounded-prefix cases and paired diagnostics.

diagnostics.method: Forge isolated external-call frame gas, using vm.lastCallGas().gasTotalUsed. These are isolated receipt-equivalent diagnostics, not new signed transaction receipts.
diagnostics.external_fee_source: Authentic historical Chainlink request and fulfillment replay through real FWA; no mocked external fees or fee debts.
diagnostics.cash_setup: The active-funding pair changes only local vault ETH to create the cash-short branch. It retains the same journal job and calldata.
limits: The one-wei price makes small genuine historical fees eligible. These pairs do not prove keeper viability at production gas prices.
Per-test gas totals include setup and must not be used as operation transaction gas.
The preserved logs contain test-result stdout chunks, not the entire process stdout. Compiler diagnostics and tool transport envelopes were omitted.

pack_quote_calibration_limits.statement: The raw gas quote covers the current signed sample. The older historical isolated sample requires the configured work fees; zero-work-fee coverage is not established for that sample. Larger packs receive a conservative linear quote.

o2.result: Still fails the original requirement. Three-unit pack, mint and listing quote constants were not lowered to manufacture a pass.

simulation_review.method: Independent source and transaction-order comparison; no broad new simulation or fork run.
simulation_review.funding_helper_result: No mismatch found between sync_fee_plan and final VaultLib._fundSync.
timed_order_checks: Acquisition selection transfers pending active fees to external credit once before the vault synchronizes its book.
Purchaser keep and kick callbacks place actual backing cash in balance before sync. They are not added again through cash_delta.
Expired positions resolved inside sync supply only their prospective net backing through cash_delta.
Journal selections, terminal reconciliation and head pruning precede actual active fee claims and payment.
Distribution-only proof uses the pruned book and the total prospective quote. Retaining original credit in the preview equals cash plus remaining credit after a sweep.
Successful collection updates active fee debt, receives its cash once, subtracts collected external credit once and replans after the transaction.

preexisting_precision_limit.description: The forward loop materializes budget refill at every event; Solidity computes a lazy refill from the last stored budget timestamp. Per-event integer truncation can conservatively reduce modeled spending permission by a few wei.
preexisting_precision_limit.asset_effect: No ETH or fee income is created. This is a permission-rounding difference, not an asset-ledger difference.
